name: patrol_sentry2_pingpong
about: sp_tutorial_1's sentry2 walks its patrol under 0x67 (docs/vtmb/npc-ai/programs.md § 'Patrol paths, walked (2026-09-12, story 10g)'). The map's logic_auto sends SetupPatrolType '999 2 FOLLOW_PATROL_PATH_WALK' (t+2.0) then FollowPatrolPath 'sentry2_1 sentry2_2 sentry2_3' (t+2.1); a map record's time zero precedes those delays, so the install is observed. The player is set down 1.5 m from sentry2 at 0.1 s: the Society hub is far from the map's start, out of the player's PVS, where retail's normal think law stretches to 16 s (docs/vtmb/npc-ai/lifecycle.md § 'The interval laws'); CBasePlayer::Teleport 0x101606a0 wakes every NPC within 2048 units (0x1028d820 -> slot 583). InputSetupPatrolType 0x1029eb30 -> 0x1029f460(reinit): type 2, repeat 999, schedule SCHED_TROIKA_FOLLOW_PATROL_PATH_WALK installed at once (0x102ae750); InputFollowPatrolPath 0x1029ed90 resolves each token on the hint Group (0x102d2840) and appends the nodes, reset (0x10307b60) and installs the schedule again. The program (cai_basenpctroika/sched_troika_follow_patrol_path_walk.sch: SET_TOLERANCE_DISTANCE 20, GET_PATH_TO_PATROL_POINT, WALK_PATH, WAIT_FOR_MOVEMENT, FACE_PATROL_INTEREST, DO_PATROL_INTEREST_ACTIVITY, NEXT_PATROL_POINT) issues one type-4 goal per point; NextPoint 0x10307b80 on type 2 steps +1 to the end, then (repeat--) turns to type 3 at first(3) = min(count-1, 0x7fff) = the LAST point again, so the far end is goaled twice in a row before the walk back: sentry2_1, sentry2_2, sentry2_3, sentry2_3, sentry2_2. Points by map Y (cm): sentry2_1 -7917, sentry2_2 -8090, sentry2_3 -9675. sentry2_3's interest record names sentry2_ip_whistle, which no entity carries, so both interest tasks complete at once.
known_red: V4: N13 (stories/v1/triage.md): the walk plays (3.650 'walk rate=1', since V3a) but the body covers ~0.44x retail's ground speed (walk_0 136.7 cm/s; StudioFrameAdvance 0x1008f120 weights m_flGroundSpeed by move_yaw), leg times unchanged by V3a, so the 15.9 m leg to sentry2_3 misses its deadline
notes: No never on taskfail after the wires (1.83 / 1.93 s): retail's own Setup-then-Follow order installs the program on an empty path for 0.1 s, and a think in that window fails TASK_GET_PATH_TO_PATROL_POINT with 0x1d (current node -1) before the nodes arrive; whether a think falls there is cadence, not a contract. The goal texts are matched on the map Y the node's hull position carries (one sign and two digits), not on a pinned coordinate. Restated 2026-10-04 (V3c integrator, Q-V13a): the pre-wire never excludes TaskFail(0x0c) 'Don't have a route': sentry2 (use_interesting) selects 0xff at its first think, competes with mercenary_upstairs for the same places, and the loser draws one with no graph node in reach (navigation-jump-links.md:157); retail fails the route once and waits 5.1-10 s in the _FAILED program (programs.md:207-220). Caveat: the docs do not confirm the exported graph is the one retail loads.
